text: Royal Street is currently at capacity as it relates to available on-street permit parking spaces. The inclusion of Royal Street into permit parking area 12A will provide much needed parking flexibility. Area 12A has 76 legal permit parking spaces. With only 46 permits issued for on-street permit parking, area 12A can accommodate additional permit holders.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Approved the amendment to Schedule B of City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 925, Permit Parking, to incorporate a revised map of permit parking area "12A", as attached to the letter (July 3, 2018) from Councillor Nunziata.
